protocol.leiden_graph: exact frozen weighted mutual-kNN graph: z-score bands, PCA-20 neighbour search, k=20, radius=7, min_degree=4, Gaussian spectral-spatial edge affinity
protocol.leiden_selector: fixed resolution grid; cross-seed and adjacent-resolution ARI; largest cluster <= 0.40; normalized entropy >= 0.35
protocol.hdbscan: sklearn.cluster.HDBSCAN defaults on StandardScaler + PCA-20; noise retained as label -1 and reported
